name: adez-md
description: ADEZ MD WhatsApp bot. Link numbers with a pair code and run commands from one bot.

BOT_NAME.description: Name shown in menus and cards

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner's number with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 254111783552)

SUPABASE_KEY.description: Supabase service key used to save and restore sessions

STAGGER_MS.description: Delay in ms between starting each saved session

START_DELAY_MS.description: Delay in ms before starting sessions, so an old copy can shut down

BOT_FONT.description: Title font: italic | bold | smallcaps | mono | normal

MENU_IMAGE.description: Optional image URL sent with the menu

AI_API_KEY.description: API key for the AI provider

AI_MODEL.description: Model name for the AI provider

YTDLP_PATH.description: Optional path to a yt-dlp binary. The Dockerfile already installs one at /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp
